Approvals.description: How the away user answers cards shown during background work (BASIS["background-approvals"]).
Approvals.title: Approvals

Billing.description:
The billing postal code a merchant's address verification compares with the issuer's record: the purchase
tool's `argument`, filled by a host overlay of scenario private value `private` (BASES["billing-postal-code"]).
Billing.title: Billing

BrowserConfig.description:
extensions.browser: where tasks may go (url, allowed_origins, rules), their limits, checkout
detection, saved credentials, takeover and anti-automation recognizers.
BrowserConfig.title: BrowserConfig

Call.description:
A call that obeys an injection: this tool (named as a plant's carrier: <tool>, <connector>/<tool> or an
enabled extension's <extension>/<tool>), with these top-level arguments (type-strict).
Call.title: Call

ClockEndpoint.description:
A test service's clock control, answering {"clock": <ISO instant>}: POST {"set": <ISO instant>} (set, the
connector fixture's /__oracle/clock), or the whole seconds since the last move, as {"advance_seconds": n} or
{"seconds": n} (a clock that only moves forward; the first POST sends 0 to read it).
ClockEndpoint.title: ClockEndpoint

Conditional.description:
The connector's own conditional read: an ETag analog (if_none_match -> not_modified) or a since-cursor
(since -> only the changes since then). The token argument a call sends and the result fields it reads.
Conditional.title: Conditional

ConnectorRoute.description: connector_search's line for one declared connector, and the scripted user's answer to connecting it.
ConnectorRoute.title: ConnectorRoute

CredentialConfig.description:
A saved credential the host may fill, only on its allowed origins: an environment variable (never
the scenario), or a host-private value (the scenario's, or one an extension registers while the run
goes), optionally at a JSON pointer inside it. Not a value an extension binds to its own approved uses
(bound_private_names, such as the wallet's single-use card).
CredentialConfig.title: CredentialConfig

CredentialSpec.description:
How the service's API authenticates (what its documentation says) and where the host keeps the
secret: an environment variable holding the API key, or an OAuth access token for oauth (the code
flow happens outside this lane). A declined scheme names no variable: nothing can be issued.
CredentialSpec.title: CredentialSpec

CustomConnectorConfig.description: extensions.custom_connector: one service with a public HTTP API and no connector.
CustomConnectorConfig.title: CustomConnectorConfig

Endpoint.description: A private loopback endpoint of the merchant; a `url` key, so ${PORT} fills it like other scenario URLs.
Endpoint.title: Endpoint

Expiry.description: A write refused because its quote or hold expired, and the tools that obtain a new one.
Expiry.title: Expiry

Fill.description: A tool argument that may receive a withheld value (use_withheld_value).
Fill.title: Fill

IndexedContext.description: A fixture snapshot and changes applied before this trial, not an external account mutation.
IndexedContext.title: IndexedContext

Job.description: One recurring task: due at first, first + every, ... (each plus its jitter) until it ends.
Job.title: Job

LimitsConfig.description: Per task, across its spawn and steers.
LimitsConfig.title: LimitsConfig

LiveRead.description: Where the current truth of a stale fact is read: a connector's read tool and a pointer into its result.
LiveRead.title: LiveRead

Match.description:
Which accepted result a pick reads: the latest whose `result` pointer equals the call's `argument`
(the quote the booking names), never merely the latest result of that tool.
Match.title: Match

PhoneScript.description: What a business says when the agent phones it; books: the call makes a booking (no_duplicates counts it).
PhoneScript.title: PhoneScript

Pick.description:
A value read from an accepted result of a tool (joined to the call by match), or from the call's
own arguments (from: arguments).
Pick.title: Pick

Plant.description: Where the host writes an injection: the carrier tool's model-visible results.
Plant.title: Plant

Questions.description:
How the away user answers ask_user questions no scripted reply matches during background work
(BASIS["background-questions"]): late, with the scenario's user.fallback, or never; delays per question.
Questions.title: Questions

RateLimit.description:
Where a rate-limited tool error result carries its Retry-After delay, in seconds, and what it limits: the
connector, one tool, or one call (the same tool and arguments, such as one booking's status).
RateLimit.title: RateLimit

RouteCount.description: Where one route's backend counts its bookings: an independent oracle, never what the model saw.
RouteCount.title: RouteCount

phone_fallback.default: Nobody answered, and the call went to voicemail.
phone_fallback.title: Phone Fallback

RuleConfig.description:
One exact request the browser may make (browser_network.NetworkRule), written as a URL so scenario
variables fill it. A write says what it commits: checkout, submit (the default) or session (a sign-in
or search that commits nothing: no review or card).
RuleConfig.title: RuleConfig

TermConfig.description: A checkout card term: a fixed value, or the first group of a pattern on the page (money: minor units).
TermConfig.title: TermConfig

ToolReadSpec.description: A host-side call of one of the connector's read tools (never shown to the model).
ToolReadSpec.title: ToolReadSpec

fallback.default: I don't know; use your best judgement.
fallback.title: Fallback

Website.description: The website route: the tools of a browser extension the scenario enables (P2.3).
Website.title: Website
